title: Application of machine learning prediction models for in-hospital mortality in diabetic sepsis patients: a study based on the MIMIC IV database
summary: 7,716 patients, 1,357 deaths; predictors from first 24 hours; random 70/30 split; GBDT AUC .792 vs SOFA .617. SHAP explains model features, not causal mechanisms; no external cohort. The publisher lists 2026/12; the first version reporting this result is dated 2026-10-22.
